<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TreeHouse" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/treehouse">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_HouseBuilt" name="House built"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_TreeHouse" name="Building a Tree House" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_TreeHouse" name="Tree house wanted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_SendReq</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_SendReq</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendReq_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from architect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendReq_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DraftMerge" name="Draft to refine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlanDecision_Refine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Refine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft with additional requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Refine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine_PlanDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PlanDecision" name="Plan final?" default="Flow_PlanDecision_Refine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine_PlanDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlanDecision_Materials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlanDecision_Refine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlanDecision_Materials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Materials_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from online stores">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Materials_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_SendBuild</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendBuildRequests" name="Send messages to friends to build house">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_SendBuild</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendBuild_HouseBuilt</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_HouseBuilt" name="House built">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendBuild_HouseBuilt</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HouseBuilt_Invitations</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_HouseBuilt" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendInvitations" name="Send party invitations to friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HouseBuilt_Invitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invitations_GuestList</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateGuestList" name="Create list of attending guests">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invitations_GuestList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GuestList_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GuestListCreated" name="Guest list created">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GuestList_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="Start_TreeHouse" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_SendReq" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendReq_Receive" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Merge" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_DraftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Refine" sourceRef="Gateway_DraftMerge" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_PlanDecision" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="Gateway_PlanDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanDecision_Materials" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanDecision" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanDecision_Refine" name="No, refine again" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanDecision" targetRef="Gateway_DraftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_SendBuild" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="SendTask_SendBuildRequests"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendBuild_HouseBuilt" sourceRef="SendTask_SendBuildRequests" targetRef="Event_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HouseBuilt_Invitations" sourceRef="Event_HouseBuilt" targetRef="SendTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_GuestList" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateGuestList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuestList_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateGuestList" targetRef="End_GuestListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
